name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary difference between custom and semi-custom cabinet installation lies in the level of customization and fit. Custom cabinet installation involves precise fitting of cabinets built to exact specifications for your space, often accommodating unique dimensions or design preferences. Semi-custom cabinets offer more flexibility than stock options, with a wider range of sizes, finishes, and accessories, but still adhere to standardized measurements. Custom installation may involve more intricate cuts and adjustments on-site to achieve a perfect, built-in look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinet installation involves fitting units built to exact specifications, while semi-custom uses standardized sizes with more finish options, requiring less on-site modification.
